professional_term: Artifact Storage Topology & Contamination Prevention Contract
principles: new operational artifacts first write to runs/<run_id>
canonical/current receives only promotion-gated approved pointers or artifacts
PATCH_REQUIRED/BLOCKED artifacts stay in runs or quarantine
downstream consumers read manifest/index/gate-approved paths, never glob latest files

topology.canonical/current: approved current artifacts and pointers only

forbidden_paths.raw_evidence: canonical/current unless promotion gate passed and stored as approved raw evidence pointer/object
